relationships.subject: Ambroxol
relationships.evidence_quote: 0.5% AH is efficacious in suppressing rat corneal pain as well as heightened nociceptor sensitivity from repetitive stimulation from irritants

key_findings: 0.5% ambroxol eye drops suppressed corneal pain and corneal sensation in rats, including a neuropathic corneal pain model.
Ambroxol up to 30 uM did not affect human corneal epithelial cell migration, proliferation or viability.
